method: Every selected pinned Hebrew verse and annotation read before drafting; individual English lines and rationales composed from the Hebrew. All 746 TSW comparator verses read afterward. No synonym replacement engine or overlap quota.

focused_reread.qualification: Reread by the drafting agent, not independent scholarly review.

post_reread_adjustments.decision: Removed unsupported to-one-another from the shout; retained yes/also singing.
Clarified the foot crushing enemies in blood; kept the pinned crush verb and the textual note.
Made the relation of righteousness to the hills bringing peace explicit rather than dropping the preposition.
Stripped bare avoids unnecessarily identifying what was taken as previously won spoils.
Made collective Israel explicit as his people while preserving he-to-I and people-to-you changes.
Supplied the city from the immediate Zion context to make the abrupt foundation clause intelligible.
Rendered the years pride as what they boast of for clearer English.

priority_findings: Complete title binding in 17 psalms; all other public labels match source labels. No source record partitioned.
YAH remains distinct from the full divine name; Lord plus LORD retained where both occur.
Psalm 68 preserves women heralds, received gifts, difficult victory imagery, and relevant textual alternatives.
Psalm 78 keeps its own history sequence, concrete violence, and memory-to-instruction structure.
Psalms 82 and 89 retain divine council language; Psalm 88 retains its dark ending.
Psalm 80 repeated refrain expands the divine address; Psalms 96 and 98 preserve their different endings.
Psalm 100:3 follows the qere and documents the written reading.
Psalm 104 preserves nonhuman life, predation, breath/spirit ambiguity, playful Leviathan and the severe final petition.
companion_impact: Psalms 65–104 quotations and bindings need later reconciliation; Companion was not modified.
continuation_authorization: Successive forty-chapter blocks authorized without routine approval pauses; source and QA standards unchanged.
